note: Source catalogs include task context and attempted inaccessible pages; source count is not a count of fully fetched winning notebooks. Original reports mark access limitations.

classical-sources.json.title: AMEX2022 first-place author writeup
classical-sources.json.access: Primary author text obtained from web search index; direct Kaggle HTML not reliably readable
observations: Author links his own released implementation and describes LGB plus NN.
limits: Released code may not exactly reproduce the maximum private score; author notes random fluctuations.

classical-sources.json.title: AMEX winner S5_LGB_main.py
limits: Thousands of engineered columns and much larger training data than HW4; not a directly transferable preset.

classical-sources.json.title: AMEX winner manual feature code
observations: Full/last3/last6 aggregation; first differences; within-customer percentile ranks; calendar-month percentile ranks.
limits: Original source combines train/test features. HW4 adaptation must preserve exact snapshot and cutoff, fit-only learned transformations.

classical-sources.json.title: AMEX winner training helper
observations: Default LGB path uses shuffled StratifiedKFold; probability predictions are averaged over saved fold models.
limits: Its CV strategy is not our causal forward validation. Merely specifying early_stopping_rounds in old DART code does not establish stopping support in the installed modern version.

classical-sources.json.title: AMEX winner S7_ensemble.py
limits: These are literal released code coefficients, not a universal weighting recipe.

classical-sources.json.title: AMEX2022 second-place JuneHomes writeup
classical-sources.json.access: Full indexed original author writeup inspected through search; direct HTML has no readable lines
observations: Independent20%holdout; early6 versus later6-month feature stress checks; specialized small-history model; some holdout-winning model blends did not transfer to leaderboard.
limits: Large-data settings and random customer-fold design cannot be copied to HW4.

classical-sources.json.title: IEEE-CIS winner Chris Deotte coauthored technical article
classical-sources.json.access: Opened full author article; AI-generated introductory summary ignored
observations: UID used for group aggregates rather than a direct input; first-place ensemble included XGB, CatBoost and LGBM.
limits: Depth12 and missing=-1 are not recommended HW4 defaults. Ordinary GroupKFold does not itself enforce chronology despite the article wording. UID-average future postprocessing is inapplicable to quarter-specific site targets.

classical-sources.json.title: IEEE winner Konstantin Yakovlev direct CatBoost parameter reply
classical-sources.json.access: Original author comment and parameters inspected via indexed primary page text; direct HTML empty
limits: A particular large-fraud-data model, not a CPU21k-row recommendation.

classical-sources.json.title: Chris Deotte original Feature Engineering Techniques
classical-sources.json.access: Original author text inspected via web search index
observations: Discusses frequency/group statistics, categorical interactions, and native-NaN versus sentinel ablation.
limits: Transductive combined train/test recipes must be rewritten for HW4 availability. Such ideas are hypotheses, not guaranteed gains.

classical-sources.json.title: HomeCredit2018 second-place author repository
observations: Author identifies own feature-engineering contribution: interval aggregates, first/last historical events, deltas and ratios.
limits: Different financial data and AUC metric.

classical-sources.json.title: HomeCredit2018 published second-place LGB component
observations: Repeated-fold rank averaging in this component.
limits: One released component, not the complete team model; random lgb.cv cannot replace temporal folds.

classical-sources.json.title: TalkingData2018 winner flowlight author repository
classical-sources.json.access: Opened complete author README including example configuration

exact_parameters.config_status: README example, not asserted final winning preset

limits: Extreme class imbalance and huge volume; downsampling is not required for HW4.

classical-sources.json.title: TalkingData winning repository time-feature generators
observations: Both past and future click-count generators and next/previous click-time deltas exist.
limits: Future-event generators are incompatible with HW4 strict prediction cutoffs.

classical-sources.json.title: Amazon Employee Access2013 winners original methodology
classical-sources.json.access: Original author text and author comments inspected via web search index
observations: Category cross-counts/frequencies, robust repeated validation and a mixture of logistic/tree models.
limits: Historical categorical non-temporal task, not a transferable split strategy.

classical-sources.json.title: Amazon Employee Access winning authors code
observations: Separate author components combined after standardization and weighted averaging.
limits: Source is from2013; not a ready current-library HW4 implementation.

classical-sources.json.title: Owen Zhang second-place original shrinkage target-encoding helper
observations: Two-/three-way counts and named shrinkage randomized leave-one-out target means; prior strengths20/40.
limits: This is not a causal temporal implementation. For HW4 write and test quarter-prefix statistics, including a past-only global prior; do not copy the old function blindly.

classical-sources.json.title: CIBMTR2025 first-place original two-target solution
classical-sources.json.access: Original author writeup text inspected via web search index
observations: Author reports best LGB/XGB depth2 versus CatBoost depth6, and adding one-hot/category copies of some inputs.
limits: Survival ranking and a different validation design; not evidence of HW4 AP gain.

classical-sources.json.title: City of Chicago Food Inspection Forecasting official project
observations: Inputs include prior violations, time since inspection, business age, inspector, weather and nearby complaint signals.
limits: Different outcome and richer covariates; not a Kaggle winner on our dataset. No confirmed mapping of our opaque codes follows from this project.

classical-sources.json.title: Chicago official binomial ridge model code
limits: Cannot reproduce unavailable inspector/weather effects in HW4.

classical-sources.json.title: Chicago official historical inspection feature code
observations: Orders by License and Inspection_Date, shifts past outcomes and violation counts, includes missing-history indicator.
limits: Code severity categories do not establish meanings of HW4 code tokens.

classical-sources.json.title: Chicago separate historical XGB experiment code
observations: Its inner-validation rows are also present in its dtrain construction.
limits: Do not copy this evaluation logic: inner early-stopping validation would leak.

classical-sources.json.title: CatBoost original NeurIPS2018 author paper
classical-sources.json.access: Primary paper text inspected via indexed PDF
observations: Authors compare Plain and Ordered and report particular Ordered benefits on smaller datasets.
limits: No HW4 result is implied.

classical-sources.json.title: CatBoost official common parameters
observations: CPU default is Plain; Ordered is a distinct mode. min_data_in_leaf is only for Depthwise/Lossguide.
limits: Inspect effective parameters in the installed version rather than assuming defaults.

classical-sources.json.title: CatBoost official categorical-transform algorithm
observations: Ordered categorical statistics use preceding permuted objects; Counter can be label-free.
limits: Does not make an externally target-encoded feature temporally causal.

classical-sources.json.title: XGBoost official parameters and PR metric definition
observations: aucpr is an interpolated PR area, so use an explicitly verified sklearn AP metric for our prefix selection.
limits: Current documented version can differ from the installed runtime; pin runtime and API.

classical-sources.json.title: LightGBM official parameter reference
observations: Rebuild Dataset or disable feature_pre_filter when tuning min_data_in_leaf; bagging_fraction requires nonzero bagging_freq.
limits: No parameter range is a guaranteed optimum.

classical-sources.json.title: LightGBM official early-stopping callback
observations: Standard early_stopping callback has no effect for DART.
limits: A DART experiment needs separately planned fixed-budget/checkpoint handling.
